audience_description: School Principals in Eduversal partner schools. Holds ultimate accountability for academic outcomes, instructional quality, operational management, compliance, and the school's relationship with yayasan and Eduversal. New principals are simultaneously enrolled in the 12-month Principal Induction track (handbook-principal-v1.json) — induction-overlay tasks layer on the weekly cadence for first-year principals.

source_inheritance.primary_source_description: The Eduversal Principal Operating Cadence v1.0 — 83 tasks across P1-P8 foci, fully Cambridge + Permendikbud + Permendikdasmen anchored. This file is the authoritative source for Principal weekly tasks.
source_inheritance.this_file_role: Adapter / mapping layer between the cadence file's 8-focus structure (P1-P8) and the weekly-checklist module's week-by-week structure. The seed script reads BOTH this file AND principal-operating-cadence.json, then expands cadence tasks onto the appropriate weeks.
source_inheritance.do_not_duplicate: Tasks defined in principal-operating-cadence.json must NOT be re-defined here. This file references them by id (e.g. T-P1-001) and adds only the week-mapping metadata.

framework_anchors.appraisal_framework: principal_appraisal_framework_v1 (when ratified) — F1 Cadence Compliance, F2 Leadership Observation, F3 Stakeholder 360, F4 Outcome Indicators, F5 Self-Assessment

task_categories: Inherited — P1-P8 from principal-operating-cadence.json. Mapped to weekly-checklist categories C1-C6 below.

cadence_to_week_expansion.description: How the seeder maps cadence tasks (D/W/M/T/A/X) to weeks 1-40.

rules.daily: Lands in weekly_essentials/school_principal — present every week, surfaced as standing items.
rules.monthly: Lands on weeks 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36, 40 (Week 4 of every month).
rules.termly: Lands on weeks 17, 38 (end of Sem-1, end of Sem-2). Some tasks specify exact weeks via specific_timing — those override.
rules.annually: Each annual task has specific_timing in cadence file (e.g. 'May-June') — the seeder maps to the corresponding weeks (e.g. May = W31-32, June = W37-39).
rules.adhoc: Lands in weekly_essentials with adhoc=true flag — UI surfaces only when triggered (not weekly).

week_specific_overrides.description: Cases where the cadence file's specific_timing maps to specific weeks, OR where a task is added beyond the cadence file (Eduversal-network-specific events).

induction_overlay.applies_when: users.induction_status in {pre_arrival, listen, diagnose, act, anchor}
induction_overlay.source: Induction Module: Principal 26-27 (live Google Doc) — repo mirror docs/induction/handbook-principal-v1.json
induction_overlay.alignment_note: Principal Induction runs 12 months from the principal's own start date, in four windows of about 90 days: Listen (days 1–90), Diagnose (91–180), Act (181–270), Anchor (271–365), after Stage 0 — Preparation (up to 45 days before arrival). The week numbers below assume a start in week 1 and are approximate; a principal who starts mid-year follows the day count, not the school calendar. A Year-1 principal receives no formal appraisal (Principal NN1).

extra_recurring_tasks_first_year.title: Mentor call with your Principal Mentor
extra_recurring_tasks_first_year.description: 60-minute video call with your external Eduversal Principal Mentor: weekly in Window 1 (Listen), bi-weekly in Windows 2 and 3, and monthly in Window 4. In Window 3 the mentor also makes one in-person school visit. Eduversal selects and assigns the mentor — an experienced Eduversal Subject Specialist with a prior school leadership background, the Foundation Representative of a different partner school, or a network-experienced retired principal under an Eduversal contract. The mentor holds active Eduversal Mentor Certification and completes a one-hour Principal Mentor Briefing; no separate endorsement document is required.

extra_recurring_tasks_first_year.title: Induction journal — listening-visit notes and reflections
extra_recurring_tasks_first_year.description: Private notes and reflections, visible only to you, your mentor and — where a task says so — your Foundation Representative / General Manager (FR/GM). Eduversal never reads named entries (Charter NN2). Nothing in the journal is used to judge you.

extra_recurring_tasks_first_year.title: Window deliverables — written, reviewed by your mentor
extra_recurring_tasks_first_year.description: School State Report (1 page, end of Window 1 — shared with your mentor and FR/GM); 3-Priority School Plan (2 pages, Window 2 — reviewed by your mentor, signed off by your FR/GM before you present it to staff); Mid-Year Reflection (1 page, Window 3); Year-2 plan and End-of-Year Principal Report (Window 4). The Induction Coordinator reviews the End-of-Year Report with your mentor's induction note and signs off completion — completed / withdrew. These are induction deliverables, not an evaluation: a Year-1 principal receives no formal appraisal.
evidence_required: Deliverable shared with mentor (and FR/GM where stated)

extra_recurring_tasks_first_year.title: Weekly pulse
extra_recurring_tasks_first_year.description: The same one-question, 5-emoji "How was your week?" check-in used across all Eduversal induction tracks. It is anonymised at network level and exists to notice when you need support — care, not surveillance. It never feeds appraisal.
